features.name: Safe Haven
features.description: Jeryth also offers Phaulkonmere as a safe haven for enclave members and their friends.

features.name: Invulnerability
features.description: In her disembodied state, Jeryth can't be harmed.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: If the need arises, Jeryth can cast any spell on the druid spell list. She uses her spells in defense of her estate and its beautiful gardens. A member of the Emerald Enclave can petition Jeryth to cast a spell, which she is happy to do if that character's renown in the enclave equals or exceeds the spell's level.

npcs.description: A noblewoman-turned-demigod and Chosen of Mielikki named Jeryth Phaulkon.

npcs.name: Broxley Fairkettle

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

npcs.description: Broxley (LG male strongheart halfling commoner) is a laid-back, law-abiding halfling with mutton chops and bushy eyebrows. Inns and taverns are few and far between in the North Ward, so he makes frequent visits to the characters' place to see how it's doing and to offer his well-wishes. If none of the characters are members of the guild, he strongly urges them to join 'to avoid further harassment.' The cost of membership in the Fellowship of Innkeepers is included in the regular expenses outlined in the 'Tavern Keeping Expenses' sidebar. Broxley has long believed the tavern to be haunted and is glad to see living souls in it once more. While lamenting the burdens of being a father of nine, he is quick to point out that the characters' continued compliance with guild rules and regulations makes his rather difficult life 'just a bitty bit easier.'

npcs.name: Hammond Kraddoc

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

npcs.description: Hammond (N male Illuskan human commoner) doesn't like adventurers, but he likes their coin. This effete, well-dressed man is always seen in the company of a young scribe, Jinny (NG female tiefling commoner), who wears spectacles and silently records notes and conversations in a small book as Hammond speaks. Hammond likes to stop by in the middle of the month to inform the characters of new spirits that the guild has to offer, and to give them a list of which ones to push hard. To test the extent of their willingness to cooperate, he chastises them for their current selection of beverages, even if he previously sold them those goods.
npcs.role: Vintners', Distillers', and Brewers' Guild representative

npcs.name: Justyn Rassk

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The thug has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the thug's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The thug makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Dead-eyed, slack-jawed Justyn (NE male Illuskan human thug) grew up in the toughest neighborhood in the Field Ward and has the scars to prove it. The guild doesn't pay him enough for him to afford a residence in the North Ward, and going to that part of the city fills his heart with resentment. He darkens the characters' doorstep once a month to deliver a cartload of chopped meat for the tavern's larder. Although delivery fees are covered by the guild's monthly dues, Justyn always demands some extra coin for his service. If the characters don't give him a gratuity of at least 3 gp, he says, 'Maybe next time the meat will be someone you know.' He lets the threat hang in the air, then departs.

npcs.name: Ulkoria Stonemarrow

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Ulkoria is an archmage. She uses teleport spells to enter and leave her home.

features.name: Shield Guardian
features.description: She's never seen without her shield guardian close by.

npcs.description: Ulkoria (NG female shield dwarf archmage) has defended Waterdeep with her magic more times than she can recall. She's known as ''the Gargoyle'' because her face is frozen in a scowl that frightens adults and children alike. No one knows where she lives, but it's believed to be underground, possibly a cellar or dungeon under one of the city's oldest estates.

npcs.name: Emmek Frewn
npcs.description: Emmek Frewn, a salty northerner (NE male Illuskan commoner), recently tried to buy the tavern in Trollskull Alley but was outbid by Volothamp Geddarm. Stung by the loss, he bought a smaller, less impressive building in the same alley and turned it into a pub, which he calls Frewn's Brews.

npcs.name: Hurv Taldred

features.name: Shadow Transformation
features.description: The Gralhunds paid a necromancer to perform a ritual on Hurv and his mastiffs. After sundown, the physical forms of these figures melt away, and they become three shadows until dawn.

npcs.description: A menacing groundskeeper named Hurv Taldred (LE male Illuskan cult fanatic) and his two quiet mastiffs.

npcs.name: Ike
npcs.description: A stableboy named Ike (commoner), who sleeps here at night. Ike is away (either picking up food for the horses or out drinking with friends) if the characters arrive during the day.

npcs.name: Grinda Garloth
npcs.description: A mad treasure hunter who lives in Mistshore. She speaks Common, Dwarvish, Halfling, and Undercommon. Her ramshackle home contains an unmade bed, an alchemist's laboratory, a small stove, a coat rack, a table, a stool, a stuffed chair in poor condition, a wash basin, and a locked wooden sea chest with a glyph of warding spell cast on it. Grinda carries the key, and the glyph triggers an explosive runes effect if anyone other than Grinda lifts the lid of the chest.

npcs.name: Ott Steeltoes

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: He has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

npcs.description: Ott is a shield dwarf cultist, with these changes: Ott is chaotic evil. He has these racial traits: His walking speed is 25 feet. He has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Dwarvish. He has an Intelligence of 6 (-2) and Religion +0.

npcs.name: Noska Ur'gray

features.name: Racial Traits
features.description: His walking speed is 25 feet. He has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Dwarvish.

features.name: Disability
features.description: He has disadvantage on Strength checks made to climb, due to his disability.

npcs.description: Noska is a ruthless enforcer in the Xanathar Guild. A green slime in Undermountain dissolved his left hand and forearm, and the lost appendage has been replaced with a heavy crossbow that attaches to the stump. Noska Ur'gray is a shield dwarf thug, with these changes: Noska is neutral evil.

npcs.name: Yevette Blackwater

features.name: Rooftop Expertise
features.description: If forced to make an ability check or a saving throw because of a chase complication, she has advantage on the roll. Also, she can take the Dash action during the chase without having to make Constitution checks to avoid exhaustion.

npcs.description: A Zhent named Yevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human swashbuckler; see appendix B) has snatched the Stone of Golorr and is fleeing as fast as she can across icy rooftops during a blizzard. Yevette was a vicious pirate before she joined the Zhentarim and rose to become one of Manshoon's favored lieutenants. She cackles madly in the face of danger and loves a good chase. She knows the streets, alleys, and rooftops of Waterdeep well.

npcs.name: Esvele Rosznar
npcs.description: A young noblewoman with a fascinating alter ego (see 'The Black Viper' in appendix B). She recently bought the old tower and found the entrance to the Vault of Dragons beneath it.

npcs.name: Sembra Vashir
npcs.description: Female Calishite human, of the Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild

npcs.name: Pynt Oomtrowl
npcs.description: Female rock gnome, of the Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild

npcs.name: Jarbokken Frostbeard
npcs.description: Male shield dwarf, of the Guild of Stonecutters, Masons, Potters, and Tile-makers

npcs.name: Umbero Zastro

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: He has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: He speaks Common and Elvish.

npcs.description: The presiding magister is Umbero Zastro, a handsome, eloquent, and fair-minded half-elf in his thirties. He's known for his finely honed sense of poetic justice and for meting out unconventional punishments. Magister Umbero Zastro has the statistics of a noble, with these changes: He is lawful neutral. He is unarmed, unarmored (AC 11), and worth 0 XP.

npcs.name: Hester Barch

features.name: Innate Psionic Ability
features.description: Unknown to all but her closest aides, the magister has the innate psionic ability to cast the detect thoughts spell without somatic or material components. After using it once, the magister must finish a short or long rest before she can cast the spell again. Wisdom is her spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

npcs.description: The courthouse magister is Hester Barch (LG female Turami human acolyte with Insight +4), a petite woman in her seventies. Magister Barch is slow to anger and fond of sharing lengthy educational anecdotes and parables.

npcs.name: Fenerus Stormcastle
npcs.description: Fenerus Stormcastle (N male Tethyrian bandit captain) is confined to a cell in area H8, waiting to stand trial. He is charged with multiple counts of theft (highway banditry) and assaults against Waterdavian citizens.

npcs.name: Losser Mirklav

features.name: Racial Traits
features.description: He is Small, and his walking speed is 25 feet. He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. He speaks Common and Halfling.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: He has the animate dead and blight spells prepared, instead of counterspell and greater invisibility. All his spell slots are currently expended.

equipment: spellbook bound in stitched flesh that contains all his prepared spells
key to the padlocked door in area B8
4d10 gp in a pouch made of elf skin and cinched with a rope made of woven dwarf hair
npcs.description: Losser Mirklav is a lightfoot halfling mage, with these changes: He is chaotic evil and has 31 (9d6) hit points. He has these racial traits: He is Small, and his walking speed is 25 feet. He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. He speaks Common and Halfling. He has the animate dead and blight spells prepared, instead of counterspell and greater invisibility. All his spell slots are currently expended.

npcs.name: Kalain

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: She has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: She has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

features.name: Art Imitates Life
features.description: Art Imitates Life (3/Day). Kalain touches one of her paintings and causes its subject to spring forth, becoming a creature of that kind provided its CR is 3 or lower. The creature appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the painting, which becomes blank. The creature is friendly toward Kalain and hostile toward all others. It rolls initiative to determine when it acts. It disappears after 1 minute, when it is reduced to 0 hit points, or when Kalain dies or falls unconscious.

npcs.description: Kalain is a half-elf bard with these changes: She is chaotic evil. She has these racial traits: She has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep. She has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. She speaks Common and Elvish. Instead of the Song of Rest trait, she has the Art Imitates Life action option.

npcs.name: Thrakkus the Butcher

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: He can use his action to exhale a 15-foot cone of fire (but can't do this again until he finishes a short or long rest); each creature in the cone must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Damage Resistance
features.description: He has resistance to fire damage.

npcs.description: Thrakkus is a dragonborn berserker of red dragon ancestry, with these changes: He is chaotic evil. He has these racial traits: He can use his action to exhale a 15-foot cone of fire (but can't do this again until he finishes a short or long rest); each creature in the cone must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. He has resistance to fire damage. He speaks Common and Draconic.

npcs.name: Barok Clanghammer (Aurinax)

features.name: Disguise
features.description: The dwarf, who calls himself Barok Clanghammer, is really the adult gold dragon Aurinax (see appendix B) in disguise. He guards the gold for Lord Dagult Neverember and holds the dragonstaff of Ahghairon (see appendix A) in exchange for his services.

features.name: Personality
features.description: Aurinax is patient, wise, merciful, and vigilant. He remains in humanoid form until combat breaks out.

equipment: staff carved and painted to resemble a pair of entwined dragons—one red, one gold
npcs.description: An aged dwarf clutching a staff carved and painted to resemble a pair of entwined dragons—one red, one gold. Despite the dwarf's age, his eyes are steady and bright. He is really the adult gold dragon Aurinax in disguise, guarding the gold for Lord Dagult Neverember.

npcs.name: Bepis Honeymaker

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.description: He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature.

features.name: Brave
features.description: He has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

npcs.description: Bepis Honeymaker is a honey merchant who was kidnapped from his Trades Ward home a month ago. The Xanathar Guild tried to ransom him back, but seemingly his relatives either couldn't pay or decided not to. Ahmaergo has put him to work as a cook but threatens to give him over to the mind flayer Nihiloor every so often.
npcs.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.??? (Chapter 5: Spring Madness, area X31)

npcs.name: Willifort Crowelle
npcs.description: As the Cassalanters' chief butler and Lord Victoro's personal attendant, Willifort Crowelle makes a point of knowing everything that transpires within the villa. If the Cassalanters have guests, he escorts them during their entire visit, using stealth if necessary. He ushers nosy guests away from areas or objects that might link the Cassalanters with the Asmodeus-worshiping cult.

npcs.name: Tisstna Khyret
npcs.description: Madame Khyret is the personal attendant to Ammalia Cassalanter and is the family's chief housemaid. Madame Khyret dresses in a long black gown and wears a headdress with black tassels. She is an aging tiefling cult fanatic, and she spends most of her time in the master sitting room (area C19).

npcs.name: Laiba "Nana" Rosse
npcs.description: Laiba Rosse, better known as "Nana," is the caretaker and private tutor for Terenzio and Elzerina, and she does her best to keep track of their every move. Even so, the two often sneak away from her watchful eye. Nana dresses in flowing red robes. She is a female tiefling cult fanatic who relaxes in the twins' playroom (area C17) when she's not with the children.

npcs.name: Jandar Chergoba
npcs.description: As the head chef of Cassalanter Villa, Jandar determines each day's menu and oversees all activity in the kitchen. Jandar is a male tiefling cult fanatic. He is often in the kitchen (area C10).

npcs.name: Breena Bafflestone

features.name: Gnome Racial Traits
features.description: They have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic. Their walking speed is 25 feet. They have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. They speak Common and Gnomish.

npcs.description: A rock gnome named Breena Bafflestone monitors the machinery at all times. Nearby is a copper speaking tube, which enables her to communicate with the control room command center (area U7b).

npcs.name: Breena Baffiestone
npcs.description: A rock gnome named Breena Baffiestone monitors the machinery at all times.

npcs.name: Soluun Xibrindas
equipment: a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets
npcs.description: Soluun Xibrindas is a neutral evil drow gunslinger, with these changes: Soluun wields a scimitar instead of a shortsword (it deals slashing damage instead of piercing damage). He wears a pair of drow-made boots of elven kind. In addition to his weapons, he carries four packets of smokepowder (see appendix A) and a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets.

npcs.name: Fel'rekt Lafeen
npcs.description: Fel'rekt is a male drow who was born female. Unhappy with the treatment of males in his society, he petitioned to join Bregan D'aerthe. Jarlaxle took a shine to Fel'rekt almost immediately, and the young drow has since become one of Jarlaxle's most loyal lieutenants. Eager to prove himself, Fel'rekt is quick to volunteer for tasks and hurls himself into combat with verve. Fel'rekt and Krebbyg Masq'il'yr are close friends and work as a team, trading banter and jokes at their enemies' expense. Fel'rekt lacks the cruelty common to most drow, and he won't kill an adversary unless he is left with no other choice.

npcs.name: Krebbyg Masq'il'yr
equipment: a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets
npcs.description: Krebbyg Masq'il'yr is a chaotic neutral drow gunslinger. In addition to his weapons, he carries four packets of smokepowder (see appendix A) and a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets.

npcs.name: Jarlaxle Baenre

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Jarlaxle wears +3 leather armor, a hat of disguise, a bracer of flying daggers (see appendix A), a cloak of invisibility, a knave's eye patch (see appendix A), and a ring of truth telling (see appendix A). He wields a +3 rapier and carries a portable hole and a wand of web. His hat is adorned with a feather of diatryma summoning (see appendix A).

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If he is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Jarlaxle instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails. He can't use this trait if he's incapacitated.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Jarlaxle has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Jarlaxle's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights
1/day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

features.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
features.description: If Jarlaxle fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Master Attuner
features.description: Jarlaxle can attune to up to five magic items, and he can attune to magic items that normally require attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
features.description: Jarlaxle deals an extra 24 (7d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Jarlaxle's that isn't incapacitated and Jarlaxle doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Suave Defense
features.description: While Jarlaxle is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Charisma modifier.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: When not wearing his knave's eye patch, Jarlaxle has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jarlaxle makes three attacks with his +3 rapier or two attacks with daggers created by his bracer of flying daggers.

actions.name: +3 Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d8 + 9) piercing damage.

actions.name: Flying Dagger
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Jarlaxle is a flamboyant, swashbuckling drow iconoclast. He leads a renegade drow faction called Bregan D'aerthe, made up of disenfranchised male drow, most of them culled from destroyed or disgraced houses. Gifted with a sharp mind, a sense of humor, puissant skill with a blade, and a wealth of useful magic items, Jarlaxle infiltrated the city of Luskan, brought a kind of order to its lawlessness, and declared himself its secret lord.

npcs.name: Lorella Middenpump
npcs.description: Lorella sits in the pilot's swivel chair, which is bolted to the floor and can be lowered or raised.

npcs.name: Tervaround Waggletop
npcs.description: Three rock gnome engineers named Lorella Middenpump, Tervaround Waggletop, and Anverth Leffery are on duty here.

npcs.name: Anverth Leffery
npcs.description: Three rock gnome engineers named Lorella Middenpump, Tervaround Waggletop, and Anverth Leffery are on duty here.

npcs.name: Karabal L'enz
npcs.description: Two drow elite warriors named Karabal L'enz and Marro Qaz'arrt guard the control room and keep the gnomes on task.

npcs.name: Marro Qaz'arrt
npcs.description: Two drow elite warriors named Karabal L'enz and Marro Qaz'arrt guard the control room and keep the gnomes on task.

npcs.name: Sidra Romeir

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10+3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Sidra Romeir is a Zhentarim veteran in black armor, playing Three-Dragon Ante in the dining room of Kolat Towers. She wears a teleporter ring.
npcs.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.156

npcs.name: Manafret Cherryport

features.name: Halfling Racial Traits
features.description: He is Small, and his walking speed is 25 feet. He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. He speaks Common and Halfling.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Manafret Cherryport is a portly halfling mage and one of Manshoon's lieutenants. He loves to cook and uses his mage hand cantrip to cut vegetables.
npcs.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.156

npcs.name: Yorn the Terror

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.description: When reduced to 0 hit points, he drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until he finishes a long rest).

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The thug makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

npcs.description: A burly half-orc clad in black leather armor sits in an overstuffed chair in the northernmost corner of the room, reading a book. Yorn values his own well-being above all else. He is initially indifferent toward intruders.

npcs.name: Kaevja Cynavern

features.name: Spellcasting Changes
features.description: She has the sending spell prepared instead of the fly spell, and she carries a yellow elemental gem.

features.name: Languages
features.description: She knows Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, and Elvish.

actions.name: Elemental Gem
actions.description: In battle, Kaevja breaks the elemental gem, summoning an earth elemental and commanding it to attack her enemies.

npcs.description: Kaevja was a Red Wizard of Thay until she saw an opportunity to study magic under Manshoon. Before he accepted her, Manshoon forced her to remove her distinctive Thayan head tattoos and to trade in her Red Wizard robes for black ones. Kaevja Cynavern is a female Mulan human mage, with these changes: Kaevja is Lawful evil. She knows Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, and Elvish. She has the sending spell prepared instead of the fly spell, and she carries a yellow elemental gem.
npcs.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.??? (Chapter 8: Winter Wizardry, area E3)

npcs.name: Havia Quickknife

features.name: Racial Traits
features.description: They are Small, and their walking speed is 25 feet. They can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. They have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. They speak Common and Halfling.

npcs.description: Havia Quickknife is a female lightfoot halfling and martial arts adept who serves Manshoon. She is lawful evil and has 49 (11d6 + 11) hit points. She wears a teleporter ring.

npcs.name: Mookie Plush

features.name: Racial Traits
features.description: They are Small, and their walking speed is 25 feet. They can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. They have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. They speak Common and Halfling.

npcs.description: Mookie Plush is a female lightfoot halfling and martial arts adept who serves Manshoon. She is lawful evil and has 49 (11d6 + 11) hit points. She wears a teleporter ring.

npcs.name: Manshoon
npcs.description: Manshoon is a handsome young male human in elegant robes, though he is much older than he looks. He is an evil archwizard and leader of the Zhentarim. He has a metal appendage attached to the withered stump of his left arm. He is not spoiling for a fight and will try to convince the characters to work for him.

npcs.name: Corylus Thann

features.name: Masked Lord
features.description: Corylus is a Masked Lord of Waterdeep, using his influence to cover up the Zhentarim's illegal activities.

npcs.description: Corylus (LE male Tethyrian human noble) is happy to let other members of his family manage the wine business while he focuses on his duties as a Masked Lord. Unfortunately, he lacks the principles and sound judgment that have led to House Thann's success in the past. He also places the welfare of humans above nonhumans. In the past, he has used Zhentarim thugs to inflict harm on nonhumans who sought positions of political power in the city. Now the Zhents are blackmailing Corylus, threatening to expose his bigotry unless he uses his influence as a Masked Lord to cover up their illegal activities.

npcs.name: Jelenn Urmbrusk

features.name: Masked Lord
features.description: Jelenn is a Masked Lord of Waterdeep, occupied with Masked Lord business.

npcs.description: Jelenn (N female Tethyrian human noble) is a proud woman in her fifties who desperately wants to get out of debt. Several bad investments ruined her money-lending business, and most of her reliable customers have turned to other providers such as the Cassalanters. Jelenn could have borrowed money from any of a number of nobles in the city or sold off some of the property her family owns in Waterdeep, but doing so would have turned her private financial woes into local gossip. Fear of that exposure led her to borrow money from the Zhentarim instead-a decision she has come to regret. The Zhents working for Manshoon promise to keep their relationship secret on the condition that she do everything in her power to further the group's welfare in Waterdeep.

npcs.name: Ahmaergo

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: Ahmaergo has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

features.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
features.description: Ahmaergo can reroll a saving throw that he fails. He must use the new roll.

features.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
features.description: As a bonus action, Ahmaergo can regain 20 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ahmaergo makes three attacks with his greataxe.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) slashing damage if Ahmaergo has more than half his hit points remaining.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Ahmaergo, Xanathar's majordomo, has a fascination with minotaurs. Although outwardly civil, the shield dwarf is as devious and corrupt as the worst devil, yet also unflinchingly loyal to his beholder master. After the beholder, Ahmaergo is the most influential member of the Xanathar Guild.

npcs.name: Ammalia Cassalanter

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Ammalia is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): friends, mage hand, mending, message
1st level (4 slots): charm person, mage armor, magic missile
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, invisibility, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): fireball, haste, tongues
4th level (3 slots): confusion, stoneskin
5th level (1 slot): hold monster

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

npcs.description: The vainglorious lady of House Cassalanter is schooled in the arcane arts. Like her husband Victoro, she worships Asmodeus. When they were young, Ammalia and Victoro signed a contract with the archdevil, trading the souls of their children for power, good health, and long life. The soul of Osvaldo, their eldest son, was taken immediately, and he was transformed into a chain devil. The souls of the younger twins, Terenzio and Elzerina, will be taken when they turn nine years old. A provision in the contract allows the Cassalanters to buy their way out of it, but doing so requires a tremendous amount of coin and a mass sacrifice of unfortunate people. While Victoro hunts for Dagult Neverember's lost cache of gold, Ammalia makes plans to host a poisoned feast in celebration of Founders' Day. Ammalia is well mannered, well read, well traveled, and exceptionally shrewd. She is known for driving a hard bargain. Her hobby is lepidopterology, and her estate has the most beautiful butterfly garden. She allows her youngest children to play in the garden under her supervision.

npcs.name: Apprentice Wizard

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The apprentice is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mending, prestidigitation
1st level (2 slots): burning hands, disguise self, shield

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Apprentice wizards are novice arcane spellcasters who serve more experienced wizards or attend school. They perform menial work, such as cooking and cleaning, in exchange for education in the ways of magic.

npcs.name: Aurinax
npcs.description: Aurinax is an adult gold dragon. He often assumes the form of an elderly gold dwarf named Barak Clanghammer, who uses the dragonstaff as a walking stick.

npcs.name: Bard

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The bard is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following bard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): friends, mage hand, vicious mockery
1st level (4 slots): charm person, healing word, heroism, sleep, thunderwave
2nd level (3 slots): invisibility, shatter

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: The bard can perform a song while taking a short rest. Any ally who hears the song regains an extra 1d6 hit points if it spends any Hit Dice to regain hit points at the end of that rest. The bard can confer this benefit on itself as well.

features.name: Taunt (2/Day)
features.description: The bard can use a bonus action on its turn to target one creature within 30 feet of it. If the target can hear the bard, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Bards are gifted poets, storytellers, and entertainers who travel far and wide, commonly found performing in taverns or in the company of jolly bands of adventurers, rough-and-tumble mercenaries, or wealthy patrons.

npcs.name: Barnibus Blastwind

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Barnibus carries a wand of magic detection.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Barnibus is a 7th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): blade ward, light, mage hand, message
1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, identify, mage armor, shield
2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): clairvoyance, sending
4th level (1 slot): locate creature, Otiluke's resilient sphere

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Barnibus works for the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors, investigating crimes that involve the use of magic. He comes across as prickly and secretive, confiding only in Saeth Cromley, a retired sergeant of the City Watch who assists in many of his investigations. A lifelong bachelor, Barnibus has a small, tidy estate in the Sea Ward that he inherited from his grandmother. When not serving the Watchful Order, he spends his days reading and writing books in his library. Barnibus uses spells that help him investigate crimes, pry secrets from the minds of suspects, and locate missing persons. He finds violence appalling and would never use his magic to inflict harm on others—even those who harm him.
npcs.role: Investigator for the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors

npcs.name: Black Viper

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: On each of her turns, the Black Viper can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If the Black Viper is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she's incapacitated.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
features.description: The Black Viper deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Black Viper that isn't incapacitated and the Black Viper doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Black Viper makes three attacks with her rapier.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

npcs.description: The Black Viper was a notorious burglar, pickpocket, mugger, and assassin who died a century ago, after a long and nefarious career. Esvele Rosznar, a brash young noble, has recently adopted the Black Viper's persona to lead a secret life of crime. Like many other nobles, Esvele gossips about the Black Viper's exploits to lend credence to the villain's mystique.

npcs.name: Davil Starsong

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Davil has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Davil is a 12th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following bard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): mage hand, mending, minor illusion, vicious mockery
1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, disguise self, sleep
2nd level (3 slots): crown of madness, invisibility, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): nondetection, sending, tongues
4th level (3 slots): compulsion, freedom of movement, polymorph
5th level (2 slots): dominate person, greater restoration
6th level (1 slot): Otto's irresistible dance

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Davil Starsong is a member of the Doom Raiders and a leader of the Black Network's Waterdeep division. He can put the characters in contact with other leaders.

npcs.name: Istrid Horn

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: Istrid has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Istrid is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): light, mending, sacred flame, spare the dying
1st level (4 slots): divine favor, guiding bolt, healing word, shield of faith
2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, magic weapon, hold person, silence, spiritual weapon
3rd level (3 slots): beacon of hope, crusader's mantle, dispel magic, revivify, spirit guardians, water walk
4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement, guardian of faith, stoneskin
5th level (1 slot): flame strike, mass cure wounds, hold monster

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Istrid makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Treasure Sense (3/Day)
actions.description: Istrid magically pinpoints precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of her.

npcs.description: Istrid Horn is the Black Network's Master of Trade and Coin in Waterdeep. She operates an illegal lending operation out of a heavily guarded warehouse in the Dock Ward.

npcs.name: Skeemo Weirdbottle

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.description: Skeemo has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Skeemo is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield
2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly
4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm
5th level (1 slot): cone of cold

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

npcs.description: Skeemo Weirdbottle is the Master of Magic for the Black Network in Waterdeep, operating a cover shop called Weirdbottle's Concoctions in the Trades Ward.

npcs.name: Tashlyn Yafeera

features.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
features.description: Tashlyn can reroll a saving throw that she fails. She must use the new roll.

features.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
features.description: As a bonus action, Tashlyn can regain 20 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tashlyn makes three attacks with her greatsword or her shortbow.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) slashing damage if Tashlyn has more than half her hit points remaining.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Tashlyn has more than half her hit points remaining.

npcs.description: Tashlyn Yafeera is Master of Arms and Mercenaries for the Waterdeep Zhentarim. She provides armor, weapons, and training to sellswords on the Black Network's payroll.

npcs.name: Tashlyn

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) slashing damage if Tashlyn has more than half her hit points remaining.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Tashlyn has more than half her hit points remaining.

npcs.description: Tashlyn is a member of the Black Network.

npcs.name: Floon Blagmaar
npcs.description: Floon, a native Waterdavian in his early thirties, is a handsome fellow but not very bright. He used to work as an escort in festhalls but is currently unemployed. Several months ago, he came upon a married noble engaging in some indiscreet behavior, and now lives off the generous bribe he is being paid to keep silent.

npcs.name: Floon

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

npcs.description: Floon is a chaotic good Illuskan human commoner with an Intelligence of 7 (-2) and a Charisma of 13 (+1). He speaks Common.

npcs.name: Hlam

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Hlam is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): guidance, light, sacred flame, spare the dying
1st level (4 slots): detect evil and good, healing word, sanctuary, shield of faith
2nd level (3 slots): calm emotions, prayer of healing, silence
3rd level (2 slots): protection from energy, remove curse, sending

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If Hlam is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails. He can't use this trait if he's incapacitated.

features.name: Magic Unarmed Strikes
features.description: Hlam's unarmed strikes are magical.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While Hlam is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hlam attacks three times using his unarmed strike, darts, or both.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, Hlam can choose one of the following additional effects:
• The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (Hlam's choice).
• The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
• The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Hlam's next turn.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quivering Palm (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is reduced to 0 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wholeness of Body (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description: Hlam regains 60 hit points.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.description: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Hlam deflects the missile. The damage he takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 27. If the damage is reduced to 0, Hlam catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and he has a hand free.

reactions.name: Slow Fall
reactions.description: Hlam reduces the bludgeoning damage he takes from a fall by 100.

legendary_actions.name: Quick Step
legendary_actions.description: Hlam moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Invisibility (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Hlam becomes invisible until the end of his next turn. The effect ends if Hlam attacks or casts a spell.

npcs.description: This venerable human monk lives in a cave halfway up the side of Mount Waterdeep. Hlam is the grand master of the Order of the Even-Handed, a small monastic group devoted to Tyr. Would-be students periodically visit him to learn the Way of the Sacred Fists, which combines cleric magic and monk training. They usually return to the city confused, bruised, and not inclined to visit again. In times of great peril, Hlam can be called on to help. Sometimes he offers pearls of wisdom, and sometimes he descends from his cave to set things right with fisticuffs. He can show up at any point in the story as a helpful figure, and the characters can visit him in his cave if they need guidance or training. The Order of the Gauntlet considers him a staunch ally. Hlam is immune to disease and doesn't require food or water. Although he ages, he suffers none of the frailty of old age.

npcs.name: Laeral Silverhand

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Laeral wears a white robe of the archmagi (accounted for in her statistics). She wields a flame tongue longsword.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: While wearing her robe of the archmagi, Laeral has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Laeral is a 19th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). Laeral has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): light, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, ray of frost
1st level (at will): detect magic, disguise self, magic missile, shield
2nd level (at will): detect thoughts, invisibility, misty step
3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fly, sending, tongues
4th level (3 slots): banishment, greater invisibility, Otiluke's resilient sphere
5th level (3 slots): cone of cold, geas, Rary's telepathic bond
6th level (2 slots): globe of invulnerability, mass suggestion
7th level (1 slot): prismatic spray, teleport
8th level (1 slot): feeblemind, power word stun
9th level (1 slot): time stop

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Laeral makes three attacks with her silver hair and flame tongue, in any combination. She can cast one of her cantrips or 1st-level spells before or after making these attacks.

actions.name: Silver Hair
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Flame Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Spellfire (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description:
Magical, heatless, silver fire harmlessly erupts from Laeral and surrounds her until she is incapacitated or until she uses an action to quench it. She gains one of the following benefits of her choice, which lasts until the silver fire ends:
• She can breathe underwater.
• She can survive without food and water.
• She is immune to magic that would ascertain her thoughts, truthfulness, alignment, or creature type.
• She gains resistance to cold damage, and she is unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the silver fire is present, she has the following additional action options:
• Cast the cure wounds spell. The target regains 1d8 + 5 hit points. After Laeral takes this action, roll a d6. On a roll of 1, the silver fire disappears.
• Cast the revivify spell without material components. After Laeral takes this action, roll a d6. On a roll of 1-2, the silver fire disappears.
• Release a 60-foot line of silver fire that is 5 feet wide or a 30-foot cone of silver fire. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried take 26 (4d12) fire damage. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After Laeral takes this action, roll a d6. On a roll of 1-3, the silver fire disappears.

npcs.description: Anamanue Laeral Silverhand was born in the Year of the Cowl (765 DR), the fifth of seven daughters of the goddess Mystra. Each of the Seven Sisters is a powerful and ageless beauty with a penchant for arcane magic. Long ago, Laeral ruled a kingdom called Stornanter and held the title of Witch-Queen of the North. After that, she led a band of adventurers called the Nine. She met and married Khelben Arunsun, who would later become the Blackstaff, the Lord Mage of Waterdeep. After Khelben died, Laeral retired from public life. She resurfaced after the Spellplague and the Sundering, weakened by Mystra's death, rebirth, and withdrawal from the world.

npcs.name: Manshoon Simulacrum

features.name: Simulacrum
features.description: Manshoon uses the simulacrum spell to create a magical duplicate of himself as needed. He has customized the spell to increase his simulacrum's hit points at the expense of its spellcasting ability. Manshoon can have only one simulacrum at any given time, and he uses it as a subordinate to command his Zhentarim minions in the field. If his simulacrum is destroyed, Manshoon creates another. Each simulacrum has the statistics of Manshoon, with these changes: The simulacrum has no special equipment. Consequently, it has AC 12 and lacks the Magic Resistance trait and the Staff of Power action option. It loses all spell slots of 6th level and higher. It has a challenge rating of 8 (3,900 XP).

npcs.description: A magical duplicate of Manshoon created via the simulacrum spell, used to command Zhentarim minions in the field.

npcs.name: Nar'l Xibrindas

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Nar'l Xibrindas is a drow mage. He prepares and casts the sending spell whenever he needs to communicate with his brother.

features.name: Eyescratch Poison
features.description: In addition to his other gear, Nar'l carries a vial containing three doses of eyescratch, a contact poison. A creature that comes into contact with the poison must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour and blinded while poisoned in this way. A lesser restoration spell or similar magic ends the effect.

equipment: vial containing three doses of eyescratch
npcs.description: Xanathar's advisor is a nervous and conniving male drow named Nar'l Xibrindas. Nar'l's house was wiped out long ago, but he and his elder brother Soluun survived and joined Bregan D'aerthe. A year ago, Nar'l was given the difficult task of infiltrating the Xanathar Guild and getting as close to the beholder as possible. Not only did he succeed, but in the course of gaining Xanathar's trust, he managed to convince the beholder to eliminate its other advisors. The beholder's paranoia will eventually cause Xanathar to question the drow's loyalty, though, and Nar'l has become increasingly worried about his future. If forced to decide between himself and Bregan D'aerthe, he'll choose the former and betray his drow allies to save his own skin. Xanathar is aware that something is off with Nar'l, and recently assigned him a grell bodyguard. The grell has instructions to dispose of Nar'l at the first sign of disloyalty.

npcs.name: Nihiloor
npcs.description: Nihiloor is a mind flayer. The illithid Nihiloor works for Xanathar, spending its days creating intellect devourers and setting them loose in the sewers of Waterdeep.

npcs.name: Orond Gralhund
npcs.description: The Gralhunds are nobles who trade in arms and mercenaries, and whose family motto is "We see both sides." Orond is the patriarch, but he's not a quick-thinking or cultured sort—and deep down, he knows it. He leaves most of the plotting and socializing to his wife, Yalah, to whom he is devoted.

npcs.name: Osvaldo Cassalanter
npcs.description: Osvaldo is a chain devil.

npcs.name: Renaer Neverember
npcs.description: Renaer Neverember is an Illuskan human who has the statistics of a swashbuckler (see page 216), with these changes: Renaer is chaotic good. He speaks Common.

npcs.name: Saeth Cromley
npcs.description: Saeth Cromley is an Illuskan human veteran, with these changes: Saeth is lawful good. He has a Charisma of 14 and Intimidation +4. He speaks Common.

npcs.name: Thorvin Twinbeard

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: He has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

equipment: large, heavy wrench that doubles as a club
npcs.description: Thorvin serves as Xanathar's chief engineer and trapsmith. He also serves the Harpers as a paid informant, keeping that faction apprised of Xanathar's plans as well as he can. Thorvin uses the ruse of maintenance inspections to cover up secret meetings he holds with Harper spies in Skullport and elsewhere. Thorvin wears iron-rimmed spectacles and carries a large, heavy wrench that doubles as a club. He also carries mason's tools, smith's tools, and thieves' tools, and has proficiency with all three.

npcs.name: Urstul Floxin
npcs.description: Urstul Floxin works for Manshoon, and he is the highest-ranking member of the Zhentarim squad stationed at House Gralhund. Urstul is a glorified thug with all the charm and breeding of a snake, but the Gralhunds tolerate him because he feeds them useful information culled from his spies throughout the city. Urstul takes his orders from Manshoon's current simulacrum, which comes and goes from House Gralhund by way of a teleportation circle (connected to the circle in Kolat Towers). Urstul is a large, heavyset man in his forties. He storms about House Gralhund like he owns the place. He has a collection of black flying snakes that he uses as couriers to deliver messages to underlings throughout the city.

npcs.name: Victoro Cassalanter

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Victoro wears a ring of protection and glamoured studded leather disguised to look like fine clothing. He carries a rod of rulership shaped like a ruby-tipped cane.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Victoro has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Victoro is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Victoro has the following cleric spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): guidance, light, mending, spare the dying, thaumaturgy
1st level (4 slots): charm person, command, detect magic, disguise self, protection from evil and good, sanctuary
2nd level (3 slots): augury, lesser restoration, mirror image, pass without trace, spiritual weapon
3rd level (3 slots): blink, clairvoyance, dispel magic, magic circle, protection from energy
4th level (3 slots): banishment, dimension door, divination, freedom of movement, polymorph
5th level (2 slots): dominate person, flame strike, modify memory, insect plague
6th level (1 slot): heal
7th level (1 slot): divine word
8th level (1 slot): earthquake

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Victoro makes two attacks with his rapier.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Shadows (2/Day)
actions.description: Victoro becomes invisible until the end of his next turn. He becomes visible early immediately after he attacks or casts a spell.

actions.name: Summon Devil (Recharges after 9 Days)
actions.description: Victoro summons a barbed devil. The devil appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Victoro, acts as Victoro's ally, and can't summon other devils. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Victoro dies, or until Victoro dismisses it as an action.

equipment: rod of rulership shaped like a ruby-tipped cane
npcs.description: The lord of House Cassalanter is a devilishly handsome half-elf who likes coin and power. He and his wife gained both by cutting a deal with Asmodeus—which involved trading away the souls of their three children.

npcs.name: Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Volo is a 1st-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): friends, mending, prestidigitation
1st level (2 slots): comprehend languages, detect magic, disguise self

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

npcs.description: The bombastic world traveler Volothamp Geddarm is enjoying some downtime in Waterdeep following a successful book tour promoting his latest work, Volo's Guide to Monsters. He spends most of his free time in the taproom of the Yawning Portal, reuniting with old friends and mulling over his next book project.

npcs.name: Yalah Gralhund
npcs.description: The lady of House Gralhund is no fool. She has a keen mind and the wisdom to discern friend from foe. She also has a husband who worships her (see "Orond Gralhund," page 213) and a house that has the resources of the Black Network at its disposal.

traps.name: Bear Trap
traps.trigger: A creature steps into a trap's square.

detection.detail: A creature that has a passive Perception score of 13 or higher spots a trap before accidentally stepping in it.

disarm.detail: As an action, a creature can try to pry open the trap, doing so with a successful DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check.

traps.effect: The creature takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage as the trap snaps shut around its ankle, and the creature is restrained until the trap is removed.
traps.area: Five squares on the map, each containing a deep puddle of muddy water with a hidden spring-loaded bear trap.
traps.description: Hidden within each puddle is a spring-loaded bear trap.

traps.name: Glyph of Warding
traps.trigger: A humanoid creature passes over the first step leading down to the underground level.

detection.detail: The glyph can't be spotted unless the dust on the floor is cleared away by a gust of wind spell or some other means. Once the dust is swept aside, a character who searches the stairs notices the glyph with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

traps.effect: The glyph erupts with magical fire in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on it. The fire spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The glyph disappears after it is triggered.
traps.description: A glyph of warding spell has been cast on the first step leading down to the underground level, set to trigger when a humanoid creature passes over the step.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Gap
traps.trigger: You come to a 10-foot-wide gap between rooftops.

detection.detail: The gap is obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must be crossed.

traps.effect: You can jump over the gap if your Strength is 10 or higher (each foot you clear costs 1 foot of movement), and you must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall prone on the far rooftop. Or you can cross the gap using a 10-foot-long rope line that stretches between the two rooftops; each foot of rope line costs 2 feet of movement.
traps.description: A gap between rooftops that must be jumped or crossed via rope.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Higher Rooftop
traps.trigger: You come to a rooftop that's 10 feet higher than the one you're on.

detection.detail: The height change is obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must be climbed.

traps.effect: Make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. On a failed check, the height change counts as 10 feet of difficult terrain.
traps.description: A rooftop that is 10 feet higher than the current one.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Lower Rooftop
traps.trigger: You come to a rooftop that's 10 feet lower than the one you're on.

detection.detail: The height change is obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must be jumped down.

traps.effect: Make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to jump down safely. On a failed check, you take damage from the fall and land prone.
traps.description: A rooftop that is 10 feet lower than the current one.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Slippery Roof
traps.trigger: A roof is slippery.

detection.detail: The slippery roof is obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must be traversed carefully.

traps.effect: Make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall prone.
traps.description: A slippery roof that can cause a fall.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Rotten Roof
traps.trigger: You step on a rotten section of roof, and it collapses underneath you.

detection.detail: The rotten section is not obvious until stepped on.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must escape after falling.

traps.effect: Make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall partway into the hole in the roof and become stuck. While stuck, you are prone and restrained. You can use an action on your turn to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, ending the effect on a success.
traps.description: A rotten roof section that collapses, trapping the character.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Loose Shingles
traps.trigger: Roof shingles or tiles give way as you step on them.

detection.detail: The loose shingles are not obvious until stepped on.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must maintain balance.

traps.effect: Make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall prone and slide 10 feet back.
traps.description: Loose shingles that cause a fall and slide.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Obstacle
traps.trigger: A rooftop protuberance such as a chimney or weather vane gets in your way.

detection.detail: The obstacle is obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must navigate around.

traps.effect: Make a DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a failed check, the obstacle counts as 5 feet of difficult terrain.
traps.description: A chimney or weather vane that impedes movement.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Startled Birds
traps.trigger: You startle a flock of birds nesting on the rooftop, and they flutter all around you.

detection.detail: The birds are obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must push through.

traps.effect: Make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the birds count as 10 feet of difficult terrain.
traps.description: A flock of birds that distracts and impedes movement.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Glyph of Warding
traps.trigger: You trigger a glyph of warding spell placed on the roof to discourage burglars.

detection.detail: The glyph is not obvious until triggered.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must resist the effect.

traps.effect: Make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you are targeted by a Tasha's hideous laughter spell, the effect of which lasts 1 minute.
traps.description: A glyph of warding that casts Tasha's hideous laughter on a failed save.

traps.name: Rooftop Chase Complication: Projectile
traps.trigger: Someone on the ground throws a rock, a snowball, or a similar projectile at you.

detection.detail: The projectile is obvious.

disarm.detail: No disarm; must dodge.

traps.effect: Make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack deals no damage but distracts you and counts as 5 feet of difficult terrain.
traps.description: A thrown projectile that distracts and impedes movement.

traps.name: Unstable Bridge
traps.trigger: More than 150 pounds of weight is applied to the bridge

detection.detail: No detection method specified

disarm.detail: No disarm method specified

traps.effect: The bridge collapses. A creature standing on a section of bridge when it collapses must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall 60 feet to the floor below.
traps.description: An unstable bridge that collapses under sufficient weight, causing creatures to fall.
traps.source: Chapter 4: Dragon Season, Map 4: Vault of Dragons

traps.name: Middle Bridge Gap
traps.trigger: A character clears the 15-foot-wide gap with a running jump and lands on the bridge

detection.detail: No detection method specified

disarm.detail: No disarm method specified

traps.effect: Part of the bridge breaks away under the character's feet on landing, forcing the character to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall to the floor below.
traps.description: A bridge with a gap that breaks away when landed on after a jump.
traps.source: Chapter 4: Dragon Season, Map 4: Vault of Dragons

traps.name: Enthralling Fresco
traps.trigger: Any creature within 30 feet of the fresco that can see it

detection.detail: A detect magic spell reveals an aura of enchantment magic on the fresco.

disarm.detail: Destroying at least one 10-foot-square section of the fresco ends the effect for all creatures. Each 10-foot-square section has AC 17, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

traps.effect: Any creature within 30 feet of the fresco that can see it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by it for 24 hours. While charmed in this way, the creature can't willingly move out of sight of the fresco and defends it to the death. If forcibly moved away from the fresco, the creature tries to find its way back. The creature can't rest while under this effect. After 24 hours, the creature gains one level of exhaustion and can repeat the saving throw if it can still see the fresco, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the effect of the fresco for 24 hours.
traps.description: A fresco that magically charms creatures that see it.

traps.name: Ol' Fire Eyes Trap
traps.trigger: Anyone who touches the false adamantine trapdoor or its pull ring

detection.detail: A successful DC 17 Intelligence (Religion) check enables a character to recognize the statue as a depiction of Gorm Gulthyn, the dwarven god of vigilance also known as Fire Eyes. A detect magic spell reveals an aura of evocation magic on the statue.

disarm.detail: No disarm method is described in the source text.

traps.effect: Rays of magical fire spring from the statue's eyes, dealing 22 (4d10) fire damage. The trap doesn't trigger if the target has total cover.
traps.area: The false trapdoor and its pull ring in area V8
traps.description: A false adamantine trapdoor set into the floor before a statue of Gorm Gulthyn. Touching the trapdoor or its pull ring triggers rays of magical fire from the statue's eyes.

traps.name: Collapsing Maze Trap
traps.trigger: A tripwire rigged halfway through the maze is triggered.

detection.detail: A character in the lead who is searching for traps spots the tripwire with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check.

disarm.detail: Once spotted, it can easily be avoided or disarmed.

traps.effect: The walls of the maze come crashing down. Every creature in the collapsing maze is hit by debris and must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.
traps.area: The entire maze in area X12
traps.description: A tripwire rigged halfway through the maze in Ahmaergo's quarters causes the walls of the maze to collapse when triggered.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.??? (Chapter 5: Spring Madness, area X12)

traps.name: Beholder Wall Carving Trap
traps.trigger: Pushing either button (the eye of a wizard carving) or using an object or spell to do so

detection.detail: Any character who studies the carvings on the west wall and succeeds on a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check notices that each wizard's eye is a button that can be pushed.

disarm.detail: A character can forcibly reset a button by making a successful DC 20 Dexterity check using thieves' tools. Once a button is pushed, it locks in place for 1 hour and can't be pushed again until that time elapses.

traps.effect: The beholder carving on the wall discharges a green ray that the character can dodge with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. If the ray hits, the character appears to be disintegrated but is actually teleported to area X34a or X34b, depending on which button was pushed.
traps.description: A wall carving of a beholder that fires a green teleportation ray when a hidden button is pushed.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.XXX

traps.name: Lockbox (Cult Regalia)
traps.trigger: Attempting to open the lockbox without the proper key

detection.detail: The lockbox is hidden under a stack of quilts bearing images of flying devils.

disarm.detail: The box can be unlocked with either Wilifort's or Tissina's golden key, or by a character who succeeds on a DC 14 Dexterity check using thieves' tools. It can also be pried open with a successful DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check.

traps.effect: The lockbox contains cult regalia (see "Cult of Asmodeus," page 115).
traps.description: A gold-embellished lockbox hidden under a stack of quilts bearing images of flying devils, containing cult regalia.

traps.name: Golden Lockbox Poison Gas Trap
traps.trigger: Opening the lockbox by any means other than a golden key

detection.detail: This trap can't be disarmed.

disarm.detail: This trap can't be disarmed.

traps.effect: Poison gas sprays out from holes in the underside of the lid, filling a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the box. The gas dissipates quickly.
traps.description: A poison gas trap on a golden lockbox hidden under the bed in the master bedroom of the Cassalanter villa.

traps.name: Cold Trap
traps.trigger: If a creature enters the vault without first saying "Gold is my shield," an intense blast of magical cold fills the room.

detection.detail: A detect magic spell reveals the secret to disabling the trap: a tiny magical glyph is inscribed in the middle of the ceiling.

disarm.detail: If this glyph is dispelled with a successful casting of dispel magic (DC 16), the trap ceases to function.

traps.effect: All creatures in the vault at that time must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
traps.description: A magical cold trap in the false vault that triggers when a creature enters without speaking the passphrase.

traps.name: Collapsing Floor
traps.trigger: Any Medium or larger creature that steps onto a 5-foot-square marked C on the map

detection.detail: The balcony floors have weakened with age.

traps.effect: The floor crumbles and falls away, leaving a gaping hole. On a failed save, the creature falls 20 feet and lands prone on the floor below (area A7) amid stone debris. On a success, the creature avoids the fall by leaping to an adjacent, unoccupied space. The sound of the collapsing floor can be heard throughout the temple.
traps.description: The balcony floors have weakened with age. Any Medium or larger creature that steps onto a 5-foot-square marked C on the map must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw as the floor crumbles and falls away, leaving a gaping hole.

traps.name: Wooden Trunk Spider Swarm Trap
traps.trigger: Lifting the lid of the wooden trunk

detection.detail: No detection check specified; trap triggers when trunk is opened.

disarm.detail: No disarm method specified.

traps.effect: Panels in the front and sides open, releasing a swarm of mechanical spiders that attacks anyone other than Jarlaxle.
traps.description: A wooden trunk that releases a swarm of mechanical spiders when opened.

traps.name: Glyph of Warding (Trapped Door)
traps.trigger: Triggered when the door is opened by anyone other than Manshoon

detection.detail: The glyph, which resembles an ornate letter M, can be found with a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

traps.effect: The glyph targets the creature that opens the door with a blindness/deafness spell (save DC 18).
traps.area: The creature that opens the door
traps.description: A glyph of warding spell has been cast on the door, set to trigger when it is opened by anyone other than Manshoon.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.150

traps.name: Floor Clamps
traps.trigger: Pulling a lever is an action that causes both clamps to release the floor, which is then magically driven upward into the ceiling.

detection.detail: The floor creaks and tilts slightly when stepped on, and it can be seen to be detached from the walls. Two oversized iron clamps on opposite sides of the room hold the floor in place. Each of these rusty mechanisms is attached to an iron lever.

traps.effect: Creatures standing on the floor are knocked prone and must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw as they slam into the ceiling, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The floor then settles a few feet below the ceiling, cutting off access to the stairs down to area K15 but leaving characters free to climb up the collapsed staircase to area K17. After 10 minutes, the floor descends to its normal level and the clamps lock it down again.
traps.description: A magical clamped floor built as a precaution in case one of the experiments went berserk.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.155

traps.name: Golem Trap
traps.trigger: The golem stands on a pressure plate. When it steps off the plate to attack someone out of its reach, the weight on the plate is lifted, causing poison gas to erupt from the holes in the walls.

detection.detail: Any character who inspects the hall for traps and succeeds on a DC 17 Wisdom (Perception) check notices 1-inch-diameter holes drilled into the walls at ankle height, set at regular intervals along the length of the passage.

traps.effect: When the trap triggers, each creature in the hall must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The gas lingers for 1 minute unless dispersed with a gust of wind spell or similar magic.
traps.description: A pressure plate trap that releases poison gas from holes in the walls when the flesh golem steps off it.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.155

traps.name: Poison Gas Trap
traps.trigger: Opening the door or entering the hall triggers the trap
traps.effect: Each creature in the hall must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The gas lingers for 1 minute unless dispersed with a gust of wind spell or similar magic. While the gas persists, a creature in the hall must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. The golem is immune to the poison gas.
traps.description: A trap that releases poison gas in the hall.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.156

traps.name: Arcane Rune
traps.trigger: The first time damage is dealt to the rune

detection.detail: A detect magic spell or similar magic reveals a powerful aura of conjuration magic around the rune. A successful DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check confirms that this rune sustains the force field around Kolat Towers, and that the rune can be destroyed.

disarm.detail: The rune can't be dispelled normally, but each successful dispel magic cast on it (DC 19) deals 16 (3d10) force damage to it.

traps.effect: The first time damage is dealt to the rune, a red slaad magically springs forth from it and attacks all creatures in the hallway. When the rune is destroyed, the force field around Kolat Towers disappears.
traps.description: An elaborate rune inscribed on the back wall that sustains the force field around Kolat Towers. It has AC 10, 22 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
traps.source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage p.156
